fullTextZH: 你好！今天我要说说10种鬼。对，鬼，
fullTextEN: Hello! Today I want to talk about 10 types of ghosts. Yes, ghosts,
10 types of ghosts.
In Chinese, there are many, many ghosts,
They are not real ghosts,
So today I will talk about
10 types of not real ghosts. Okay,
The first one is a lazy ghost,
A lazy ghost is a person,
He is very lazy,
He doesn't want to work,
Doesn't want to study,
He doesn't want to do anything.
Then we can say: Ah!
He is very lazy, he is a lazy ghost.
Okay, this is the first one,
Are you a lazy ghost?
Hmm, I think you are not,
Because you are learning Chinese,
So you are not a lazy ghost.
Am I a lazy ghost,
Hmm, sometimes I am,
Sometimes I'm not.
Okay, what's the second one?
The second one is a slob,

fullTextZH: 邋遢鬼就是一个人很邋遢很乱。
fullTextEN: A slob is someone very messy and disorganized.

fullTextZH: 比如说一个人他不喜欢洗头，
fullTextEN: For example, a person who doesn't like to wash their hair,
Their hair is very messy,
They don't like to wash their face,
Their face is very dirty.
Right, they don't like to clean,
Maybe they don't like to bathe.
Hmm~
So we can say: Ah!
This person is a slob.
Are you a slob?
Okay, the third one,
The third one is a poor ghost.
Poor means having no money,

fullTextZH: 所以穷鬼就是一个没有钱的人。
fullTextEN: So a poor ghost is a person with no money.

fullTextZH: 一般来说我们会说自己是穷鬼，
fullTextEN: Generally, we say we are poor ghosts,
If you call someone a pauper,

fullTextZH: 我觉得听起来有一点点不好。
fullTextEN: I think it sounds a little bit bad.
Right, so you can say: Ah!
I am a pauper.

fullTextZH: 但是不要说他是一个穷鬼。
fullTextEN: But don't say he is a pauper.
Okay, are you a pauper?
I am a pauper.
Okay, the fourth one,
The fourth one is a drunkard,

fullTextZH: 酒鬼就是非常喜欢喝酒的人。
fullTextEN: A drunkard is someone who really likes to drink.

fullTextZH: 如果一个人他每天喝酒，
fullTextEN: If a person drinks every day,
and then he gets very, very drunk,

fullTextZH: 那我们可以说这个人是一个酒鬼。
fullTextEN: then we can say this person is a drunkard.
Are you a drunkard?
I am not a drunkard,
I don't like drinking that much,
so I won't drink every day.
Okay, so we have drunkards,
of course we also have gamblers.
What is a gambler?

fullTextZH: 就是一个人非常喜欢赌博，
fullTextEN: It's just that a person really likes gambling,
Maybe he often gambles,
Then we can say:
He is a gambling addict.
I hate gambling addicts the most,

fullTextZH: 我真的非常非常不喜欢赌博的人。
fullTextEN: I really, really dislike people who gamble.
So, of course, I'm not a gambling addict,
I don't like gambling at all.
What about you? Do you like gambling?
Okay, the sixth one,
The sixth one is a cheapskate.
If a person is very stingy, um~
For example, you go to eat with him,
He doesn't want to pay,
You pay every time.

fullTextZH: 我们可以说这个人很小气，
fullTextEN: We can say this person is very stingy,
Right, so if there is a person
He rarely, rarely pays,
You can say: Ah!
You are a cheapskate.
Or you are very stingy.
Okay, the seventh one is coward.

fullTextZH: 胆小鬼就是一个人很怕
fullTextEN: A coward is someone who is very afraid.
Very timid,
For example, someone who is very afraid,
He doesn't dare to be home alone,
He doesn't dare to walk alone,

fullTextZH: 他不敢一个人去旅游。对，
fullTextEN: He doesn't dare to travel alone. Right,

fullTextZH: 那我们可以说他很胆小，
fullTextEN: Then we can say he is very timid,
He is a coward,
Are you a coward?
I think I am.

fullTextZH: 因为如果我一个人在家，
fullTextEN: Because if I am home alone,
I am also very afraid,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得我是一个胆小鬼。
fullTextEN: So I think I am a coward.
Okay, the eighth one is lecher. Right,
A lecher is someone who is very lecherous,
For example,

fullTextZH: 如果他看到一个很漂亮的女人，
fullTextEN: If he sees a very beautiful woman,
Then he drools,
Then we can say, ah!
He is a lecher.
Of course, if one

fullTextZH: 个人看到一个非常好看的男人，
fullTextEN: person sees a very handsome man,
then he drools,

fullTextZH: 我们也可以说他是色鬼，
fullTextEN: we can also say he is a lecher,
If a person is very lecherous,
then he is very old,

fullTextZH: 我们也可以说他是一个老色鬼。
fullTextEN: we can also say he is an old lecher.
Are you a lecher?
Do you have lecherous friends?
You can tell me.
Okay, the ninth is 'foreign devil',

fullTextZH: 洋鬼子是一个有一点老的词，
fullTextEN: 'Foreign devil' is a somewhat old term,

fullTextZH: 以前可能中国人觉得外国人看起来
fullTextEN: In the past, Chinese people might have thought foreigners looked
very different,

fullTextZH: 所以我们觉得他们看起来是鬼的样子。
fullTextEN: so we thought they looked like ghosts.
We generally call, um~
Westerners 'foreign devils',
Yes, generally white people,

fullTextZH: 我们会说他们是洋鬼子。
fullTextEN: We would call them foreign devils.

fullTextZH: 如果你听到一个中国人叫你洋鬼子，
fullTextEN: If you hear a Chinese person call you a foreign devil,
Would you feel very angry?

fullTextZH: 可能你会觉得有一点点不开心。
fullTextEN: Maybe you would feel a little unhappy.
But I think this word

fullTextZH: 真的是很早很早以前的词，
fullTextEN: is really a very old word,

fullTextZH: 因为以前中国人没有看到很多
fullTextEN: because in the past Chinese people didn't see many
foreigners' faces,

fullTextZH: 所以觉得啊他们看起来很不一样，
fullTextEN: so they thought they looked very different,

fullTextZH: 很可怕。所以我们叫他们洋鬼子，
fullTextEN: very scary. So we called them foreign devils,

fullTextZH: 如果你听到了不要生气，
fullTextEN: if you hear it, don't get angry,

fullTextZH: 现在可能很多很多中国人觉得洋鬼子很好看。
fullTextEN: now maybe many Chinese people think foreign devils are good-looking.
Okay, the last one,

fullTextZH: 第十个如果你不喜欢一个人，
fullTextEN: The tenth one, if you don't like someone,
you hate someone,
maybe because he is very noisy,
maybe because he is very lazy,
maybe because he is very messy,
maybe because he is very stupid,

fullTextZH: 那你都可以说他是一个讨厌鬼。
fullTextEN: then you can call him an annoying ghost.
Yes, annoying person.

fullTextZH: 好，所以今天我说了10种鬼，
fullTextEN: Okay, so today I talked about 10 types of ghosts,
Which type are you?
Leave a comment to tell me.
Then see you next time, bye!
